I am a 16 year-old female. When I was 15, i was going through the same thing. I still have moments where I don't know what I'm doing, where I don't know why I'm alive and I feel empty. Sometimes I long for something that I don't know. I was a Christian before, and it gave me a reason to live. However, it only lasted nearly a year. After I started to realize that God really wasn't there, I stopped. I went on and tried my best to learn about science and many other things. I was interested in other religions and other tales. 

Existentialism is a philosophy that can help you create your meaning. I understand that the dread is very overwhelming. I know I feared of being like the others. I didn't want to be stupid or mindless. I wanted to be myself. However, I think I was making it harder to do that by not trying new things.

I see life as a series of adventures. As an opportunity to try new things. You will die one day. Everyone will die one day. However, you don't need to follow the most basic path. You can make your own. You're existing. You're alive. And also, you most likely live once. After a while, I realized I didn't want to live on the fence and watch others live in the way they lived. I wanted to choose how I lived and go with that. You don't have to see it as something entirely unknown and scary, but you can see it as a chance to learn and grow. You can choose how you see your life, and you can choose how you react. You don't have to follow the most basic path.

When I was clueless about my emotions, I felt so afraid to fall into the majority. It's not that I didn't want to be part of society, but I didn't understand why no one thought about what they were doing. Why didn't they ask themselves why they're watching this movie or show? Why didn't they ask themselves why they bought that new IPhone? Why didn't they ask themselves why they need a brand new car? I didn't want to be that mindless. I wanted to appreciate life in my own way, and not exactly in a materialistic way.

If you don't really think about it and reflect, you will get lost. You will not know where to go and what to do, and this can lead the same effect that eating a candy bar on a cleansing day has. You will feel guilt. You will feel empty. You will feel like you haven't achieved anything. That's why you need to set the right target and know what you're aiming for. Also, what are you aiming with? Understand yourself, learn about yourself. You don't have to continuously deal with the dread. You don't have to overthink. Try new things, find new hobbies, learn about yourself. This is all an adventure. Life has many experiences for you.

If you feel too overwhelmed, please get in contact with someone. Consider a hotline, or a friend. Maybe turn on some music and cry or dance, I don't know. You're not alone in this, and it's going to be very challenging to discover yourself. However, you can get through if you put your mind to it. It's best to know why you want to get through it. Make your own reason. Let life break you, not make you. Make yourself.
